home.ctaText: Anyone can suggest a new listing or a correction. No coding needed.

about.title: About
about.intro: Online in Cambodia helps people find the official online channels of organizations, businesses and places in Cambodia, and see which platforms they are not on.
about.why: It's often hard to tell whether a shop is on Telegram, whether an NGO has a website, or whether a Facebook page is the official one or a fake. This directory answers those questions in one place, and shows where Cambodia's digital presence still has gaps.
about.how: Every listing shows each platform as available (with a link), not available, or unknown. A platform is only marked not available when an editor has checked. Each listing has sources and a last-verified date.
about.open: The website code is open source under the MIT license, and the data is open under CC BY-SA 4.0. Anyone can reuse it with credit.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.intro: You don't need to be a developer to help. Every suggestion is reviewed by an editor before it appears on the site.
contribute.suggestText: Fill in a short form with the name, platforms and a source link.
contribute.correctText: Tell us what changed: a new page, a closed account, a broken link.
contribute.fakeText: Seen a page pretending to be a listed organization? Let us know.
contribute.codeText: Developers and writers can contribute on GitHub. Start with the contributing guide.
contribute.editorText: Editors add and verify listings. Open an issue titled "Editor request" to volunteer.
contribute.githubNote: These forms open on GitHub. You'll need a free GitHub account.

data.title: Data & license
data.intro: All directory data is free to reuse under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license (CC BY-SA 4.0).
data.credit: Data from Online in Cambodia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0
data.download: The raw data lives in the content folder of the GitHub repository, one YAML file per listing. Downloadable JSON and CSV exports are planned.
data.logos: Logos and brand names belong to their owners and are shown only to identify each listing. They are not covered by the data license.
data.corrections: Listings contain public information only. If you represent a listed organization and want something corrected or removed, please send a correction request.
